B0875M5LYG.title: “The Name of the Game”
B0875M5LYG.synopsis: When a Supe kills the love of his life, A/V salesman Hughie Campbell teams up with Billy Butcher, a vigilante hell-bent on punishing corrupt Supes -- and Hughie’s life will never be the same again.

B0875JCQVG.title: "Cherry"
B0875JCQVG.synopsis: The Boys get themselves a Superhero, Starlight gets payback, Homelander gets naughty, and a Senator gets naughtier.

B0875L16ZV.title: "Get Some"
B0875L16ZV.synopsis: It’s the race of the century. A-Train versus Shockwave, vying for the title of World’s Fastest Man. Meanwhile, the Boys are reunited and it feels so good.

B0875H3RT2.title: "The Female of the Species"
B0875H3RT2.synopsis: On a very special episode of The Boys… an hour of guts, gutterballs, airplane hijackings, madness, ghosts, and one very intriguing Female. Oh, and lots of heart -- both in the sentimental sense, and in the gory literal sense.

B0875GT96Z.title: "Good for the Soul"
B0875GT96Z.synopsis: The Boys head to the “Believe” Expo to follow a promising lead in their ongoing war against the Supes. There might -- MIGHT -- be a homicidal infant, but you'll have to see for yourself.

B0875T75LF.title: "The Innocents"
B0875T75LF.synopsis: SUPER IN AMERICA (2019).  Vought Studios.  Genre: Reality.   Starring: Homelander, Queen Maeve, Black Noir, The Deep, A-Train, Starlight, Tara Reid, Billy Zane.

B0875J5Q86.title: "The Self-Preservation Society"
B0875J5Q86.synopsis: Never trust a washed-up Supe -- the Boys learn this lesson the hard way. Meanwhile, Homelander digs into his past, Starlight discovers that love hurts, and if you’re ever in Sandusky, Ohio and a girl asks if she can touch your gills, say NO.

B0875LY99F.title: "You Found Me"
B0875LY99F.synopsis: Season Finale Time! Questions answered! Secrets revealed! Conflicts… conflicted! Characters exploded! And so much more!

entities.synopsis: Everyone loves superheroes. They swoop out of the sky and save the day. This city’s in thrall to them: we buy their toys, watch their movies, read their fawning headlines. But if you knew just half of what supes get up to, you’d think again. That’s where Butcher comes in. He’s here to spank those supes when they get out of line. And he won’t rest until he’s done with each and every one of them.
